summary: Verified /api/security/events endpoint gating against the LIVE preview backend. All 6 tests pass. Confirms the user-reported 404 was a transient artifact; correct behavior is 401-without-token, 200-with-valid-token. Route is registered, gated by SEC-002, and healthy.
action_items: Inform user: GET /api/security/events?device_id=<dev> WITHOUT X-DM-Token correctly returns 401 (not 404). The 404 they observed was a transient during a backend restart. Native app should: 1) POST /verify-access to obtain token, 2) send X-DM-Token header on GET/DELETE /events. POST /events remains ungated for background logging.
critical_code_review_comments: Verified: POST /events ungated (correct for background logging by device), GET/DELETE /events call _require_session with device-bound token binding — cross-device token use is rejected (401). Lifecycle POST->GET->DELETE->GET works cleanly.
test_credentials: Fresh device created per test run: setup {device_id: evt-test-<rand>, access_code:'2580'}; token obtained via /verify-access.
seed_data_creation: Two throwaway devices (evt-test-<rand>) created per module for token-binding test. No cleanup of these test devices was performed (no admin delete endpoint used).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_events_gating.py is a good regression harness for SEC-002 event gating + token binding + full CRUD lifecycle. Hits the LIVE preview URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Reusable pattern: setup -> verify-access -> use X-DM-Token header.
rca of the issue: User reported 404 on GET /api/security/events?device_id=test. RCA: route /api/security/events is registered and returns 401 when X-DM-Token is missing (SEC-002 gating via _require_session). The 404 was a transient error during a backend supervisor restart (route not yet mounted). Mitigation: none needed on backend; the native/Android client must obtain a session token via POST /api/security/verify-access and send X-DM-Token on GET/DELETE /events.
